shloka_text: एवमास्ते महाबाहुरहन्यहनि राघवः । प्रशासत्सर्वकार्याणि पौरजानपदेषु च ।। 7.38.1 ।।
transliteration: evamāste mahābāhurahanyahani rāghavaḥ | praśāsatsarvakāryāṇi paurajānapadeṣu ca || 7.38.1 ||
translation: एवम् thus, आस्ते remained, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, अहन्यहनि day after day, राघवः Rama, प्रशासत् ruling, सर्वकार्याणि all affairs, पौरजानपदेषु among the citizens and country people, च and,
explanation: Thus, the mighty-armed Rama lived day after day, administering all affairs concerning both the city dwellers and the rural populace.
comments: Rama dismisses his allies to their homes -- King Janaka returns to Mithila escorted by Bharata, his uncle Yudhajit to Kekaya with Lakshmana, Pratardana of Kashi to Varanasi, and the three hundred other kings to their lands -- thanking them and crediting their valour for Ravana's fall, he sends them off amid mutual affection.

shloka_text: ततः कतिपयाहःसु वैदेहं मिथिलाधिपम् । राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.38.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu vaidehaṃ mithilādhipam | rāghavaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.38.2 ||
translation: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after a few days, वैदेहं to the king of Videha, मिथिलाधिपम् the lord of Mithila, राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed,
explanation: Then, after a few days, Rama, with folded hands, spoke these words to Janaka, the king of Videha and lord of Mithila.

shloka_text: भवान्हि गतिरव्यग्रा भवता पालिता वयम् । भवतस्तेजसोग्रेण रावणो निहतो मया ।। 7.38.3 ।।
transliteration: bhavānhi gatiravyagrā bhavatā pālitā vayam | bhavatastejasogreṇa rāvaṇo nihato mayā || 7.38.3 ||
translation: भवान् you, हि indeed, गतिः refuge, अव्यग्रा steadfast, भवता by you, पालिताः protected, वयम् we, भवतः your, तेजसः by the might, उग्रेण fierce, रावणः Ravana, निहतः killed, मया by me,
explanation: You are indeed our steadfast refuge, and we have been protected by you; it was by your fierce might that Ravana was killed by me.

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकूणां च सर्वेषां मैथिलानां च सर्वशः । अतुलाः प्रीतयो राजन्सम्बन्धकपुरोगमाः ।। 7.38.4 ।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ maithilānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | atulāḥ prītayo rājansambandhakapurogamāḥ || 7.38.4 ||
translation: इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, च and, सर्वेषां of all, मैथिलानां of the Maithilas, च and, सर्वशः in every respect, अतुलाः incomparable, प्रीतयः affections, राजन् O King, सम्बन्धकपुरोगमाः headed by the relationship (of marriage),
explanation: O King, the affections between all the Ikshvakus and all the Maithilas, especially those stemming from our marital relationship, are truly incomparable.

shloka_text: तद्भवान्स्वपुरं यातु रत्नान्यादाय पार्थिव । भरतश्च सहायार्थं पृष्ठतस्ते ऽनुयास्यति ।। 7.38.5 ।।
transliteration: tadbhavānsvapuraṃ yātu ratnānyādāya pārthiva | bharataśca sahāyārthaṃ pṛṣṭhataste 'nuyāsyati || 7.38.5 ||
translation: तद् therefore, भवान् you, स्वपुरं to your own city, यातु may go, रत्नानि jewels, आदाय taking, पार्थिव O King, भरतश्च and Bharata, सहायार्थं for assistance, पृष्ठतः behind, ते you, अनुयास्यति will follow,
explanation: Therefore, O King, you may return to your city taking the jewels, and Bharata will follow behind you for assistance.

shloka_text: स तथेति नृपः कृत्वा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । प्रीतो ऽस्मि भवतो राजन्दर्शनेन नयेन च ।। 7.38.6 ।।
transliteration: sa tatheti nṛpaḥ kṛtvā rāghavaṃ vākyamabravīt | prīto 'smi bhavato rājandarśanena nayena ca || 7.38.6 ||
translation: सः he, तथा so be it, इति thus, नृपः the king, कृत्वा having said, राघवं to Rama, वाक्यं words, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, भवतः your, राजन् O King, दर्शनेन by the sight, नयेन by the wisdom, च and,
explanation: Having agreed, King Janaka then spoke to Rama, saying, "O King, I am pleased by your sight and your wisdom."

shloka_text: यान्येतानि तु रत्नानि मदर्थं सञ्चितानि वै । दुहित्रे तानि वै राजन्सर्वाण्येव ददामि च ।। 7.38.7 ।।
transliteration: yānyetāni tu ratnāni madarthaṃ sañcitāni vai | duhitre tāni vai rājansarvāṇyeva dadāmi ca || 7.38.7 ||
translation: यानि which, एतानि these, तु indeed, रत्नानि jewels, मदर्थं for my sake, सञ्चितानि collected, वै indeed, दुहित्रे to my daughter, तानि those, वै indeed, राजन् O King, सर्वाणि all, एव certainly, ददामि I give, च and,
explanation: O King, I give all these jewels, which were collected for my sake, to my daughter.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थं जनको हृष्टमानसः । प्रययौ मिथिलां श्रीमांस्तमनुज्ञाय राघवम् ।। 7.38.8 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutsthaṃ janako hṛṣṭamānasaḥ | prayayau mithilāṃ śrīmāṃstamanujñāya rāghavam || 7.38.8 ||
translation: एवं thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थं to Rama, जनकः Janaka, हृष्टमानसः with a joyful mind, प्रययौ departed, मिथिलां to Mithila, श्रीमान् glorious, तं him, अनुज्ञाय having taken leave of, राघवम् Rama,
explanation: Having thus spoken to Rama, the glorious Janaka, with a joyful mind, took leave of Rama and departed for Mithila.

shloka_text: ततः प्रयाते जनके केकयं मातुलं प्रभुः । राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.38.9 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prayāte janake kekayaṃ mātulaṃ prabhuḥ | rāghavaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.38.9 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, प्रयाते having departed, जनके Janaka, केकयं to Kekaya, मातुलं maternal uncle, प्रभुः the lord, राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यं words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed,
explanation: After Janaka had departed, Lord Rama, with folded hands, then spoke these words to his maternal uncle, Kekaya.

shloka_text: इदं राज्यमहं चैव भरतश्च सलक्ष्मणः । आयत्तास्त्वं हि नो राजन्गतिश्च पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.38.10 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ rājyamahaṃ caiva bharataśca salakṣmaṇaḥ | āyattāstvaṃ hi no rājangatiśca puruṣarṣabha || 7.38.10 ||
translation: इदं this, राज्यम् kingdom, अहं I, चैव and indeed, भरतश्च Bharata and, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, आयत्ताः dependent, त्वं you, हि indeed, नः our, राजन् O King, गतिश्च and refuge, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: O King, O best among men, this kingdom, I, Bharata, and Lakshmana are all dependent on you, for you are indeed our refuge.

shloka_text: राजा हि वृद्धः सन्तापं त्वदर्थमुपयास्यति । तस्माद्गमनमद्यैव रोचते तव पार्थिव ।। 7.38.11 ।।
transliteration: rājā hi vṛddhaḥ santāpaṃ tvadarthamupayāsyati | tasmādgamanamadyaiva rocate tava pārthiva || 7.38.11 ||
translation: राजा the king, हि indeed, वृद्धः old, सन्तापं sorrow, त्वदर्थम् for your sake, उपयास्यति will experience, तस्मात् therefore, गमनम् departure, अद्यैव today itself, रोचते is suitable, तव for you, पार्थिव O prince.
explanation: The old king will indeed suffer sorrow for your sake, therefore, O prince, your departure today itself is suitable.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेनानुयात्रेण पृष्ठतो ऽनुगमिष्यते । धनमादाय विपुलं रत्नानि विविधानि च ।। 7.38.12 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenānuyātreṇa pṛṣṭhato 'nugamiṣyate | dhanamādāya vipulaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || 7.38.12 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अनुयात्रेण as a follower, पृष्ठतः from behind, अनुगमिष्यते will follow, धनम् wealth, आदाय taking, विपुलं abundant, रत्नानि jewels, विविधानि various, च and.
explanation: Lakshmana will follow behind as a companion, taking abundant wealth and various jewels.

shloka_text: युधाजित्तु तथेत्याह गमनं प्रति राघवम् । रत्नानि च धनं चैव त्वय्येवाक्षय्यमस्त्विति ।। 7.38.13 ।।
transliteration: yudhājittu tathetyāha gamanaṃ prati rāghavam | ratnāni ca dhanaṃ caiva tvayyevākṣayyamastviti || 7.38.13 ||
translation: युधाजित् Yudhājit, तु and, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, गमनं departure, प्रति regarding, राघवम् to Rama, रत्नानि jewels, च and, धनं wealth, चैव and indeed, त्वय्येव in you alone, अक्षय्यम् inexhaustible, अस्तु let it be, इति thus.
explanation: Yudhājit then said to Rama regarding his departure, "So be it; let the jewels and wealth indeed be inexhaustible in you alone."

shloka_text: प्रदक्षिणं स राजानं कृत्वा केकयवर्धनः । रामेण हि कृतः पूर्वमभिवाद्य प्रदक्षिणम् ।। 7.38.14 ।।
transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ sa rājānaṃ kṛtvā kekayavardhanaḥ | rāmeṇa hi kṛtaḥ pūrvamabhivādya pradakṣiṇam || 7.38.14 ||
translation: प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, सः he, राजानं the king, कृत्वा having done, केकयवर्धनः the enhancer of Kekaya (Yudhājit), रामेण by Rama, हि indeed, कृतः done, पूर्वम् previously, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation.
explanation: Having circumambulated the king, Yudhājit, the enhancer of Kekaya, departed, just as Rama had previously saluted and circumambulated.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेन सहायेन प्रयातः केकयेश्वरः । हते ऽसुरे यथा वृत्रे विष्णुना सह वासवः ।। 7.38.15 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena sahāyena prayātaḥ kekayeśvaraḥ | hate 'sure yathā vṛtre viṣṇunā saha vāsavaḥ || 7.38.15 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, सहायेन with help, प्रयातः departed, केकयेश्वरः the lord of Kekaya, हते when killed, असुरे the demon, यथा just as, वृत्रे Vritra, विष्णुना by Vishnu, सह with, वासवः Indra.
explanation: The lord of Kekaya departed with Lakshmana's help, just as Indra, with Vishnu, went after the demon Vritra was killed.

shloka_text: तं विसृज्य ततो रामो वयस्यमकुतोभयम् । प्रतर्दनं काशिपतिं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.38.16 ।।
transliteration: taṃ visṛjya tato rāmo vayasyamakutobhayam | pratardanaṃ kāśipatiṃ pariṣvajyedamabravīt || 7.38.16 ||
translation: तम् him, विसृज्य having dismissed, ततः then, रामः Rama, वयस्यम् friend, अकुतोभयम् fearless, प्रतर्दनम् Pratardana, काशिपतिम् the lord of Kashi, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then, having dismissed that fearless friend, Rama embraced Pratardana, the lord of Kashi, and spoke this.

shloka_text: दर्शिता भवता प्रीतिर्दर्शितं सौहृदं परम् । उद्योगश्च कृतो राजन्भरतेन त्वया सह ।। 7.38.17 ।।
transliteration: darśitā bhavatā prītirdarśitaṃ sauhṛdaṃ param | udyogaśca kṛto rājanbharatena tvayā saha || 7.38.17 ||
translation: दर्शिता shown, भवता by you, प्रीतिः affection, दर्शितम् shown, सौहृदम् friendship, परम् supreme, उद्योगः effort, च and, कृतः made, राजन् O King, भरतेन by Bharata, त्वया by you, सह with.
explanation: O King, you have shown great affection and supreme friendship, and you, along with Bharata, have made a great effort.

shloka_text: तद्भवानद्य काशेय पुरीं वाराणसीं व्रज । रमणीयां त्वया गुप्तां सुप्रकाशां सुतोरणाम् ।। 7.38.18 ।।
transliteration: tadbhavānadya kāśeya purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ vraja | ramaṇīyāṃ tvayā guptāṃ suprakāśāṃ sutoraṇām || 7.38.18 ||
translation: तत् therefore, भवान् you, अद्य today, काशेय O King of Kashi, पुरीम् city, वाराणसीम् Varanasi, व्रज go, रमणीयाम् beautiful, त्वया by you, गुप्ताम् protected, सुप्रकाशाम् well-illuminated, सुतोरणाम् with beautiful arches.
explanation: Therefore, O King of Kashi, you should go today to your beautiful city of Varanasi, which is protected by you, well-illuminated, and adorned with beautiful arches.

shloka_text: एतावदुक्त्वा चोत्थाय काकुत्स्थः परमासनात् । पर्यष्वजत धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतम् ।। 7.38.19 ।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā cotthāya kākutsthaḥ paramāsanāt | paryaṣvajata dharmātmā nirantaramurogatam || 7.38.19 ||
translation: एतावत् thus much, उक्त्वा having said, च and, उत्थाय having risen, काकुत्स्थः Rama, परमासनात् from his excellent seat, पर्यष्वजत embraced, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, निरन्तरम् closely, उरोगतम् to his chest.
explanation: Having said this much, the righteous Rama rose from his excellent seat and embraced him closely to his chest.

shloka_text: विसर्जयामास तदा कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः । राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातः काशीशो ऽप्यकुतोभयः । वाराणसीं ययौ तूर्णं राघवेण विसर्जितः ।। 7.38.20 ।।
transliteration: visarjayāmāsa tadā kausalyānandavardhanaḥ | rāghaveṇābhyanujñātaḥ kāśīśo 'pyakutobhayaḥ | vārāṇasīṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ rāghaveṇa visarjitaḥ || 7.38.20 ||
translation: विसर्जयामास sent away, तदा then, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः the one who increases Kaushalya's joy (Rama), राघवेण by Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातः permitted, काशीशः the lord of Kashi, अपि also, अकुतोभयः fearless, वाराणसीं to Varanasi, ययौ went, तूर्णं quickly, राघवेण by Rama, विसर्जितः dismissed.
explanation: Then, Rama, who brings joy to Kaushalya, dismissed the fearless lord of Kashi, who, having been permitted and sent off by Rama, quickly returned to Varanasi.

shloka_text: विसृज्य तं काशिपतिं त्रिशतं पृथिवीपतीन् । प्रहसन्राघवो वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम् ।। 7.38.21 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya taṃ kāśipatiṃ triśataṃ pṛthivīpatīn | prahasanrāghavo vākyamuvāca madhurākṣaram || 7.38.21 ||
translation: विसृज्य having dismissed, तं that, काशिपतिं lord of Kashi, त्रिशतं three hundred, पृथिवीपतीन् kings, प्रहसन् smiling, राघवः Rama, वाक्यं words, उवाच spoke, मधुराक्षरम् sweet-worded.
explanation: Having dismissed that lord of Kashi and three hundred other kings, Rama, with a smile, spoke words that were sweet.

shloka_text: भवतां प्रीतिरव्यग्रा तेजसा परिरक्षिता । धर्मश्च नियतो नित्यं सत्यं च भवतां सदा ।। 7.38.22 ।।
transliteration: bhavatāṃ prītiravyagrā tejasā parirakṣitā | dharmaśca niyato nityaṃ satyaṃ ca bhavatāṃ sadā || 7.38.22 ||
translation: भवतां your, प्रीतिः affection, अव्यग्रा undisturbed, तेजसा by valor, परिरक्षिता protected, धर्मः righteousness, च and, नियतः firm, नित्यं always, सत्यं truth, च and, भवतां your, सदा always.
explanation: Your unwavering affection is protected by your valor, and your righteousness and truth are always constant.

shloka_text: युष्माकं चानुभावेन तेजसा च महात्मनाम् । हतो दुरात्मा दुर्बुद्धी रावणो राक्षसाधमः ।। 7.38.23 ।।
transliteration: yuṣmākaṃ cānubhāvena tejasā ca mahātmanām | hato durātmā durbuddhī rāvaṇo rākṣasādhamaḥ || 7.38.23 ||
translation: युष्माकं your, च and, अनुभावेन by influence, तेजसा by valor, च and, महात्मनां of great souls, हतः killed, दुरात्मा evil-minded, दुर्बुद्धी ill-intentioned, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसाधमः the vilest of rakshasas.
explanation: It is by your influence and the valor of you great souls that the evil-minded, ill-intentioned Ravana, the vilest of rakshasas, was killed.

shloka_text: हेतुमात्रमहं तत्र भवतां तेजसा हतः । रावणः सगणो युद्धे सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवः ।। 7.38.24 ।।
transliteration: hetumātramahaṃ tatra bhavatāṃ tejasā hataḥ | rāvaṇaḥ sagaṇo yuddhe saputrāmātyabāndhavaḥ || 7.38.24 ||
translation: हेतुमात्रं merely an instrument, अहं I, तत्र there, भवतां your, तेजसा by valor, हतः killed, रावणः Ravana, सगणः with his retinue, युद्धे in battle, सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवः with his sons, ministers, and relatives.
explanation: In that matter, I was merely an instrument; it was by your valor that Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, ministers, and relatives, was killed in battle.

shloka_text: भवन्तश्च समानीता भरतेन महात्मना । श्रुत्वा जनकराजस्य काननात्तनयां हृताम् ।। 7.38.25 ।।
transliteration: bhavantaśca samānītā bharatena mahātmanā | śrutvā janakarājasya kānanāttanayāṃ hṛtām || 7.38.25 ||
translation: भवन्तः you (plural, respectful), च and, समानीताः brought together, भरतेन by Bharata, महात्मना by the great-souled one, श्रुत्वा having heard, जनकराजस्य of King Janaka, काननात् from the forest, तनयां daughter, हृताम् abducted.
explanation: You all were brought here by the great-souled Bharata, having heard that King Janaka's daughter was abducted from the forest.

shloka_text: उद्युक्तानां च सर्वेषां पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम् । कालो व्यतीतः सुमहान्गमनं रोचयाम्यतः ।। 7.38.26 ।।
transliteration: udyuktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pārthivānāṃ mahātmanām | kālo vyatītaḥ sumahāngamanaṃ rocayāmyataḥ || 7.38.26 ||
translation: उद्युक्तानां of those who were ready, च and, सर्वेषां of all, पार्थिवानां of kings, महात्मनाम् of great-souled ones, कालः time, व्यतीतः passed, सुमहान् very long, गमनं departure, रोचयामि I approve, अतः therefore.
explanation: A very long time has passed since all you great-souled kings were ready, therefore I approve of your departure.

shloka_text: प्रत्यूचुस्तं च राजानो हर्षेण महता वृताः । दिष्ट्यां त्वं विजयी राम स्वराज्ये ऽपि प्रतिष्ठितः ।। 7.38.27 ।।
transliteration: pratyūcustaṃ ca rājāno harṣeṇa mahatā vṛtāḥ | diṣṭyāṃ tvaṃ vijayī rāma svarājye 'pi pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 7.38.27 ||
translation: प्रत्यूचुः replied, तं to him, च and, राजानः kings, हर्षेण with joy, महता great, वृताः filled, दिष्ट्यां fortunately, त्वं you, विजयी victorious, राम O Rama, स्वराज्ये in your own kingdom, अपि also, प्रतिष्ठितः established.
explanation: The kings, filled with great joy, replied to him, saying, "Fortunately, O Rama, you are victorious and re-established in your own kingdom."

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या प्रत्याहृता सीता दिष्ट्या शत्रुः पराजितः । एष नः परमः काम एषा नः पीतिरुत्तमा ।। 7.38.28 ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā pratyāhṛtā sītā diṣṭyā śatruḥ parājitaḥ | eṣa naḥ paramaḥ kāma eṣā naḥ pītiruttamā || 7.38.28 ||
translation: दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्रत्याहृता brought back, सीता Sita, दिष्ट्या fortunately, शत्रुः enemy, पराजितः defeated, एषः this, नः our, परमः highest, कामः desire, एषा this, नः our, पीतिः joy, उत्तमा supreme.
explanation: Fortunately, Sita has been brought back, and fortunately, the enemy has been defeated; this is our highest desire and our supreme joy.

shloka_text: यत्त्वां विजयिनं राम पश्यामो हतशात्रवम् ।। 7.38.29 ।।
transliteration: yattvāṃ vijayinaṃ rāma paśyāmo hataśātravam || 7.38.29 ||
translation: यत् that, त्वां you, विजयिनं victorious, राम O Rama, पश्यामः we see, हतशात्रवम् with enemies slain.
explanation: Our greatest joy is that we see you, O Rama, victorious and with your enemies slain.

shloka_text: एतत्त्वय्युपपन्नं च यदस्मांस्त्वं प्रशंससे । प्रशंसार्ह न जानीमः प्रशंसां वक्तुमीदृशीम् ।। 7.38.30 ।।
transliteration: etattvayyupapannaṃ ca yadasmāṃstvaṃ praśaṃsase | praśaṃsārha na jānīmaḥ praśaṃsāṃ vaktumīdṛśīm || 7.38.30 ||
translation: एतत् This, त्वयि in you, उपपन्नं is fitting, च and, यत् that, अस्मान् us, त्वं you, प्रशंससे praise, प्रशंसार्ह O worthy of praise, न not, जानीमः we know, प्रशंसां praise, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशीम् such.
explanation: It is fitting for you to praise us, but O worthy of praise, we do not know how to utter such praise in return.

shloka_text: आपृच्छामो गमिष्यामो हृदिस्थो नः सदा भवान् । वर्तामहे महाबाहो प्रीत्यात्र महता वृताः । भवेच्च ते महाराज प्रीतिरस्मासु नित्यदा ।। 7.38.31 ।।
transliteration: āpṛcchāmo gamiṣyāmo hṛdistho naḥ sadā bhavān | vartāmahe mahābāho prītyātra mahatā vṛtāḥ | bhavecca te mahārāja prītirasmāsu nityadā || 7.38.31 ||
translation: आपृच्छामः We take leave, गमिष्यामः we shall go, हृदिस्थः residing in the heart, नः our, सदा always, भवान् you, वर्तामहे we have been, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रीत्या with affection, अत्र here, महता great, वृताः filled, भवेत् may there be, च and, ते your, महाराज O great king, प्रीतिः affection, अस्मासु in us, नित्यदा always.
explanation: We take our leave and shall depart, for you will always reside in our hearts; O mighty-armed one, we have been filled with great affection here, and O great king, may your affection for us always remain.

shloka_text: बाढमित्येव राजानो हर्षेण परमान्विताः । उचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राघवं गमनोत्सुकाः ।। 7.38.32 ।।
transliteration: bāḍhamityeva rājāno harṣeṇa paramānvitāḥ | ucuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve rāghavaṃ gamanotsukāḥ || 7.38.32 ||
translation: बाढम् Very well, इति thus, एव indeed, राजानः kings, हर्षेण with joy, परम supreme, अन्विताः endowed with, उचुः said, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, सर्वे all, राघवं to Rama, गमनोत्सुकाः eager to depart.
explanation: All the kings, filled with supreme joy and eager to depart, said "Very well" to Rama with folded hands.

shloka_text: पूजिताश्चैव रामेण जग्मुर्देशान्स्वकान्स्वकान् ।। 7.38.33 ।।
transliteration: pūjitāścaiva rāmeṇa jagmurdeśānsvakānsvakān || 7.38.33 ||
translation: पूजिताः Honored, च and, एव indeed, रामेण by Rama, जग्मुः they went, देशान् to their countries, स्वकान् their own, स्वकान् their own.
explanation: Honored by Rama, they all departed to their respective countries. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टात्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 38 ।। Thus ends the thirty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
